Compare relationship matrices: pedigree, genomic and single-step

Source: R/asr_compare.R
asr_compare.Rd

Runs the same scenarios with several inverse relationship matrices - e.g. A^-1 (pedigree BLUP), G^-1 (GBLUP) and H^-1 (single-step GBLUP) - and stacks the genetic parameters and the cross-validation summaries with a method column, so the methods can be compared directly. All methods use the same folds, so the comparison is paired.

asr_compare(
  sc,
  inverses,
  scenarios = c("st_sp", "st_mp", "mt_sp", "mt_mp"),
  dir = ".",
  inbreeding = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

sc

Output of mintyr::cv_scenarios().

inverses

Named list of inverse relationship matrices, e.g. list(ABLUP = ainv, GBLUP = ginv, ssGBLUP = hinv). The names become the method column and the file tags.

scenarios

Scenarios to run (see asr_scenarios()).

dir

Folder for the workbooks: one per scenario and method (<scenario>_<method>.xlsx) plus compare.xlsx; NULL writes nothing.

inbreeding

Optional named list of inbreeding tables, one per method (same names as inverses); missing entries use the defaults of asr_gblup() (e.g. F from ainverse()).

...

Further arguments for asr_gblup(), e.g. fixed = ~ hhys.

Value

A list with param and summary (all methods and scenarios, with method and scenario columns) and results, the asr_scenarios() output of every method.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ainv <- ainverse(ped)
ginv <- G.inverse(G, sparseform = TRUE)$Ginv.sparse
cmp  <- asr_compare(sc, list(ABLUP = ainv, GBLUP = ginv),
                    scenarios = c("st_sp", "st_mp"), fixed = ~ hhys)
cmp$summary[type == "pa"]
} # }
